benchmark: HaluEval Calibration and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) Studies

outside_source_first.primary_citation: Reproducible experiments on HaluEval (arXiv:2305.11747 and follow-ups). Domain shifts (general queries ~18% halluc base rate); post-hoc Platt scaling reduces ECE from 0.08 to 0.009. Models overconfident on hallucinations; say I do not know and temperature as mitigations.
outside_source_first.key_numbers_summary: ECE improvements significant with calibration; raw LLM judges often poorly calibrated. Length/format biases in detection.
outside_source_first.demonstrated_limits: Detection post-generation; calibration helps but does not prevent root causes. Benchmarks can be gamed by simple heuristics.

spiral_associations.tie_in: HaluEval ECE directly maps to grandmas-wisdom Bullshit Meter (target >=7-8 for tenable claims) and PIE (uncertainty/partial identifiability leading to overconfidence). DAER can prune overconfident volatile branches pre-generation. Our baselines enforce citation/provenance before confidence is assigned.

cosmic_scribe_usage: For claim or generation theory: 1) Cite HaluEval calibration paper + ECE numbers first (0.08 raw to 0.009 calibrated; 18% base in general). 2) Associate to grandmas-wisdom/PIE/DAER for preemptive vs post-hoc. 3) Use test_runner with G_exp. 4) Our gate would require evidence before high confidence scores.
